as_told.title: Eric Walker admits he was at the Kecksburg crash

plain: Eric Walker, a former president of Penn State University, is said to have been present at the 1965 crash of an unknown object at Kecksburg, a small town in Pennsylvania. Jesse Michels returns to this link several times. He says Walker was "supposedly" there. He also says the people at the site reported that a civilian was in charge, and that this civilian was likely Walker, who he calls an alleged member of Majestic 12, a rumoured secret committee said to govern the UFO matter. A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb says Walker made the claim himself, in meetings with the researchers William Steinman and Henry Azadehdel. The researcher Grant Cameron says he was part of it. He says he had someone call Walker back to ask whether he had been at Kecksburg, and Walker answered, "I was there. So what?" If true, it would place a senior university figure with possible ties to a secret UFO group at a crash site.
